definitions.gloss: following blindly; tagging along; following suit
definitions.explanation: Following someone or something without independent thought or initiative. Often implies uncritical compliance or imitation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追従|ついじゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To follow the major companies' lead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追従|ついじゅう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: We followed other companies' lead and lowered our prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追従|ついじゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: True reform cannot be achieved by merely following those in power.

notes: Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form {追従|ついじゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to follow, to tag along). Common collocations: {追従|ついじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ (to be unrivaled, to be beyond compare — literally "not allowing others to follow"). Note: the same kanji {追従|ついしょう} with a different reading means "flattery" or "sycophancy" — a completely different meaning. The reading {追従|ついじゅう} specifically means following/imitating. Related: {追随|ついずい} (following — very close synonym, slightly more formal), ⟦{模倣|もほう}→模倣：15752_mohou⟧ (imitation — emphasizes copying).
